observations.quote:
I’d suggest the cooperative word puzzle for the final twenty minutes: the printed sheets are ready, and it gives all six guests a chance to work together as the meetup wraps up.

The quick card game is equally practical, especially if you’d prefer a familiar game led by volunteers who already know the rules. Both activities fit the time, cost nothing, and appeal to everyone.
